content: Sosua ahpw pirida nimensehngie, ih oh mehn Israel koaros ahpw mweselsang ar kahnimpwal nan Akasia kolahng Pillap Sordan. Irail eri keiruhdi wasao mwohn arail kotehla Sordan.
Eri, mwurin rahn siluh, arail kaun akan ahpw kohkohseli nan kahnimpwalo
oh pakapakairkihong aramas akan, “Ni ahnsou me samworo kan pahn kapaikada Kopwahn Inoun KAUN-O, amwail Koht, kumwail koaros pahn wahda amwail dipwisou oh kaparewei mwurirail.
Pwe ih duwen amwail pahn diarada alamwail me kumwail pahn keid ie, pwehki kumwail sohte kin pwarek wasaht mahso. Ahpw kumwail dehpa karanih Kohpwao; kummwail pahn alu elep en mwail mwuri.”
Sosua ahpw ndaiong aramas akan, “Kumwail pein kasarawihkumwailla, pwehki lakapw KAUN-O pahn ketin wia manaman ekei nanpwungamwail.”
Sosua eri pil padahkihong samworo kan, “Kumwail ale Kohpwahn Inow en, oh tieng mwohn aramas akan.” Re ahpw kapwaiada koasoandien Sosua.

Eri, KAUN-O ahpw ketin mahsanihong Sosua, “Me I pahn wia rahnwet kahrehiong mehn Israel koaros ar pahn wiahkinuhkala aramas lapalap emen, oh irail pahn esehla me I kin iang uhk duwehte ei kin ieiang Moses.
Eri, ke pahn padahkihong samworo kan me wa Kohpwahn Inowo, ‘Ni amwail pahn lel ni pillapo, kumwail pahn uhdi nan pihlo ahpw ni keile’.”
Sosua eri padahkihong aramas akan, “Kumwail kohdo mahs, oh rong dahme KAUN-O, amwail Koht, pahn ketin mahsanih.

Rahnwet kumwail pahn esehda me Koht ieias kin ketiket nanpwungamwail. Eri, ni amwail kohkohwei, e pahn ketin kausasang mwohmwail mehn Kenan kan, mehn Id kan, mehn Ip kan, mehn Peris kan, mehn Kirkas kan, mehn Amor kan, oh pil mehn Sepus kan.
Kohpwahn Inoun kaunen sampah pwon pahn kotehla Pillap Sordan mwohmwail.
Eri, met kumwail pilada aramas ehk riemen, wademen sang nan kadaudok en Israel kan.

Ni ahnsou me samworo kan me wa Kohpwahn Inoun Kaunen sampah pwon pahn kerediong nan pihlo, Pillap Sordan pahn tokedisang eh pwilipwil, a pihl me pwilido sang palipowehn pillapo pahn pwilpene wasatehkis.”
Eri, ahnsowo ahnsoun rahk ahpw lapakehda. Mehn Israel ko ahpw pedoisang wasa me re keiruhdi ie pwe re en kotehla Pillap Sordan. Samworo kan ahpw tieng mwohrail oh wahda Kohpwahn Inowo.
Ni arail lel ni keilen Pillap Sordan oh kerediong nan pihlo,

pihlo ahpw tokedi, sohla pwilipwil. Pihlo eri kadirehla wasao, kohdahla lel ni kahnimw Adam; Adam iei kahnimw ehu me mi limwahn Saredan. Pihl me kin pwilipwildilahng Seden Mehla pil katoketokdi, oh aramas akan ahpw kakehr kotehla pihlo kohla kerenlahng Seriko.
Eri, ni ahnsou me irail kotehla, re alu nan wasa madekeng. Samworo kan me wa Kohpwahn Inoun KAUN-O ahpw kesikesihnen pohn pwehl madekeng nanwerengen Sordan, lao aramas koaros kotehla pillapo.
